name: Nicky is my Secret Santa?!
source:
You just participated in Secret Santa, and drew the name ‘Nicky’. She’s super cute, but you don’t know her well enough to buy her a present… maybe if you ask her out you can change that?

[From [url=https://bunnygirlnicky.itch.io/nicky-is-my-secret-santa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚参加完“秘密圣诞老人”交换礼物活动，抽中了Nicky的名字。她非常可爱，可你还不够了解她，不知道该买什么礼物……也许约她出去，就能多认识她一点？

[引自[url=https://bunnygirlnicky.itch.io/nicky-is-my-secret-santa]Itch.io[/url]]
